claim_boundary: asep development train/validation comparison of K=1 standard wrong-partner specificity supervision against an otherwise matched zero-specificity-loss arm. Test and external-test roles remain sealed.

data.feature_boundary: The official AsEP ESM2-t12-35M tensors are a native-dataset baseline and are not interchangeable with the SAbDab2 ESM2-t33-650M authority.

reciprocal_partner_panel.known_limit: Exact-sequence clusters are not structural clusters; development partner margins are exploratory until a structure-cluster panel is frozen.

development_endpoints.selection: minimum of fixed-antigen/wrong-antibody and fixed-antibody/wrong-antigen cluster-weighted interaction-only margins

evidence_boundary_at_freeze.claim_boundary: Development schema and labels have been audited. No fitted model or official test result exists.

interpretation_rules: A development-only result is not an external benchmark result.
A positive residue AUPRC without a positive interaction-only partner margin does not establish partner specificity.
AsEP epitope_group is an official grouped split but is not automatically equivalent to the SAbDab2 Foldseek/TM-score antigen-fold split.
Official ESM2-35M results and ESM2-650M transfer results must be reported separately.

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum bidirectional validation compatibility margin; break ties within 0.0001 by mean per-complex contact AUPRC and then earlier epoch

negative_sample_ablation.comparison: paired five-seed K=1 versus zero-weight ablation

prerequisites: all five selected checkpoints and their SHA-256 digests frozen
temperature and thresholds frozen from validation
test adapter and scorer source hashes frozen
test reciprocal panel frozen from label-independent metadata
SAbDab2-to-AsEP PDB, exact-sequence, and structural-similarity decontamination receipt frozen
official_test_opening_rule.prohibited: No architecture, seed, checkpoint, calibration, threshold, or exclusion may be selected from official test performance.

project.name: FrameContact
project.purpose: Native AsEP development and frozen-test benchmark for contact-first partner-aware modeling

training_objective.contact: class-balanced BCE on official bipartite contact edges
training_objective.marginals: class-balanced paratope and epitope BCE derived from the same contact edges
training_objective.specificity: bidirectional ranking loss against frozen matched non-cognate partners
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: Wrong partners are ranking examples, never fabricated all-zero contact labels.
